description: Combining 12-month absolute momentum (trend) with 1-month relative momentum (strength) captures both time-series and cross-sectional momentum premia; selecting stocks with positive 12m return and highest 1m momentum should outperform pure cross-sectional momentum; falsified if forward Sharpe is not higher than the best 126d skip 21 strategy (currently -3.36).
title: Dual Momentum · 12m/1m · Top 500 · Long Only
